title: Model DOS/4GW startup PIT command and channel ports
description: Continue the -k startup path past DOS AH=35h. The next observed I/O is byte OUT 0x36 to port 0x43 at guest 0x001C8C8E. Add a deterministic 8253/8254 PIT host model for command/data writes and reads, integrate it into Unicorn's port hooks without swallowing unrelated ports, test control-word and channel latch behavior, then replay the original-byte probe to the next gate.
acceptance: The observed 0x43 <- 0x36 write is recorded and applied to channel 0 state
Subsequent channel data reads/writes have deterministic, unit-tested behavior
Unsupported unrelated port access remains traceable and stops execution
Original-byte -k passes PIT setup and records the next exact gate
No UI or gameplay state is claimed without visual/input evidence
